_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Snapshot compiled 2026-09-26 from cited Brazilian public records. Allegations and roles are time-bound to source dates; a charge or prosecutor allegation is not a conviction. Public senior figures only, country-level regions only, no operational route or enforcement-weakness information. No photos included because reuse rights were not verified.
